disq.translation: abbr. disqualified 不合适的，被剥夺资格的

disqualification.definition:
n. unfitness that bars you from participation
n. the act of preventing someone from participating by finding them unqualified
disqualification.translation:
n. 不适合, 剥夺资格, 不合格, 无资格
[法] 无资格, 不合格, 取消资格

disqualifications.definition:
n. unfitness that bars you from participation
n. the act of preventing someone from participating by finding them unqualified
disqualifications.translation: n. 不合格；取消资格；被罚下场

disqualified.definition:
s. disqualified by law or rule or provision
s. barred from competition for violation of rules
disqualified.translation: v. 使无资格, 使不合格, 使不能( disqualify的过去式和过去分词 ); 不及格

disqualified goods.translation: [经] 不合格物品, 不合格货物

disqualifies.definition:
v make unfit or unsuitable
v declare unfit
disqualifies.translation: v. 使无资格, 使不合格, 使不能( disqualify的第三人称单数 )

disqualify.definition:
v. make unfit or unsuitable
v. declare unfit
disqualify.translation: vt. 使不适合, 取消...资格

disqualifying.definition:
v make unfit or unsuitable
v declare unfit
a depriving of legal right; rendering legally disqualified
disqualifying.translation: v. 使无资格, 使不合格, 使不能( disqualify的现在分词 )

disquality.translation: [法] 取消...资格, 使不合格

disquantity.definition: v. t. To diminish the quantity of; to lessen.
disquantity.translation: vt. [废语]减少, 减量; [韵律学]取消(音节)的韵律音量

disquiet.definition: n. the trait of seeming ill at ease
disquiet.translation:
vt. 打搅, 使烦恼, 使忧虑, 使不安
n. 不安, 焦虑, 不平静

disquieted.translation: v. 使不安, 使忧虑, 使烦恼( disquiet的过去式和过去分词 )

disquieting.translation: a. 使不安的, 使焦虑的, 使不平静的

disquietly.definition:
adv. In a disquiet manner; uneasily; as, he rested
   disquietly that night.

disquiets.definition:
n a feeling of mild anxiety about possible developments
n the trait of seeming ill at ease
v disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
disquiets.translation:
n. 忧虑( disquiet的名词复数 ); 不安; 内心不平静; 烦恼
v. 使不安, 使忧虑, 使烦恼( disquiet的第三人称单数 )

disquietude.definition: n feelings of anxiety that make you tense and irritable
disquietude.translation: n. 不安, 忧虑, 焦虑

disquisition.definition: n. an elaborate analytical or explanatory essay or discussion
disquisition.translation: n. 专题论文, 研究, 探讨

disquisitional.definition:
a. Pertaining to disquisition; of the nature of
   disquisition.

disquisitions.definition: n. an elaborate analytical or explanatory essay or discussion
disquisitions.translation: n. 专题论文, 专题演讲( disquisition的复数形式 )

disquisitive.definition:
a. Relating to disquisition; fond discussion or
   investigation; examining; inquisitive.
disquisitive.translation: a. 研究的, 探讨的
